answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) based on instances of encoder-decoder architecture provide a strong standard for generative applications of NLP, such as summarization or machine translation... Machine translation is the representative of this group that we focus on, but other tasks such as summarization, vision captioning, question answering or in-context learning are also applications of the described framework.

answer_2.quote: We collect evaluations of BLEU in the default settings of SacreBLEU, obtaining a single (average) evaluation of in-domain (ID) BLEU and a set of corresponding evaluations for all listed domains... The results are evaluated using SacreBLEU and BERTScore.
